tabs.name: SYSTEM_CONFIG
tabs.purpose: Global settings, day boundary, night window, active period, Drive folder IDs, feature flags and partition strategy.

tabs.name: USERS
tabs.purpose: Login identity, role, employee link, branch scope and MFA-ready fields. password_hash is scrypt; never a plaintext password.

columns.name: location_scope
columns.note: ALL or comma separated location_id list

columns.name: must_change_password
columns.note: Y = the person must choose a new password at the next sign-in

tabs.name: ROLES
tabs.purpose: Permission matrix. The API enforces exactly what this tab says (deny by default).

columns.name: scope
columns.note: ALL | BRANCH | TEAM | SELF

tabs.name: EMPLOYEES
tabs.purpose: Employee master. weekly_off_pattern is a list of day codes (e.g. SAT,SUN); weekend_mask is derived.

columns.name: weekly_off_pattern
columns.note: Day codes: MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT,SUN

columns.name: bank_account_ref
columns.note: masked reference only, e.g. ****1234

tabs.name: EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY
tabs.purpose: Joining, transfer, promotion, confirmation, salary revision, resignation, exit and rehire events.

tabs.name: EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENTS
tabs.purpose: Employee document metadata. The binary lives in a restricted Drive folder; only the Drive file id and checksum are stored here.

tabs.name: DEPARTMENTS
tabs.purpose: Department master.

tabs.name: DESIGNATIONS
tabs.purpose: Designation and grade master.

tabs.name: LOCATIONS
tabs.purpose: Branch / site with timezone and geofence settings.

tabs.name: SHIFT_MASTER
tabs.purpose: Shift definitions. start_time/end_time are time-of-day; end <= start means the shift crosses midnight.

tabs.name: SHIFT_ROSTER
tabs.purpose: Date-wise shift assignment. A roster row overrides the employee default shift and weekly off pattern.

tabs.name: HOLIDAYS
tabs.purpose: Holiday calendar. location_id = ALL applies company wide.

columns.name: location_id
columns.note: ALL or a location_id

columns.name: effective_date
columns.note: serial 1 (1899) = inactive/blank; keeps NETWORKDAYS holiday range numeric

tabs.name: LEAVE_TYPES
tabs.purpose: Leave types including WFH / OD / travel / comp-off categories that override absence.

columns.name: count_holidays_weekoffs
columns.note: Y = holidays / weekly offs inside the range consume balance

tabs.name: LEAVE_POLICIES
tabs.purpose: Eligibility, accrual, pro-rata, carry-forward and encashment rules per leave type and employment type. One ACTIVE row per policy_key.

columns.name: probation_lock
columns.note: Y = nothing accrues before probation_end_date

tabs.name: LEAVE_BALANCES
tabs.purpose: Balance per employee x leave type x leave year, computed from LEAVE_TRANSACTIONS. accrual_pending is what the monthly accrual job must post as an ACCRUAL transaction.

columns.name: accrual_pending
columns.note: amount the accrual job posts as an ACCRUAL transaction

tabs.name: LEAVE_TRANSACTIONS
tabs.purpose: Leave ledger. Balances change ONLY through rows in this tab. days is signed: credits > 0, debits < 0. Reversals are new rows.

tabs.name: LEAVE_APPLICATIONS
tabs.purpose: Leave / WFH / OD applications and approval state. days_count is formula-derived (holidays and weekly offs excluded unless the type counts them).

columns.name: balance_available
columns.note: available balance excluding this application own pending hold

tabs.name: ATTENDANCE_EVENTS
tabs.purpose: Immutable raw punch events. Rows are only appended. Corrections go to ATTENDANCE_ADJUSTMENTS. event_datetime is company-local wall clock; event_datetime_utc is the audit instant.

columns.name: geo_lat
columns.note: latitude captured on the device at the moment of the punch (decimal degrees, WGS84)

columns.name: geo_lng
columns.note: longitude captured on the device at the moment of the punch

columns.name: geo_accuracy
columns.note: GPS accuracy radius in metres reported by the device

columns.name: geo_distance_m
columns.note: metres between the punch and the branch centre (blank when the branch has no coordinates)

columns.name: is_dup
columns.note: same employee + type within DUPLICATE_WINDOW_SEC of an earlier punch

columns.name: segment_minutes
columns.note: IN->OUT pairing: minutes between an OUT and the latest earlier valid IN that has no OUT in between

columns.name: work_date
columns.note: IN uses the day-boundary rule; a paired OUT inherits its IN work date, so night / cross-midnight shifts stay on one day

columns.name: map_url
columns.note: Google Maps link for the punch location, built from geo_lat / geo_lng

tabs.name: ATTENDANCE_DAILY
tabs.purpose: Final calculated daily attendance. Only employee_id and work_date are input (scaffolded per period); everything else is a formula derived from events + roster + holidays + leave + adjustments + shift policy.

columns.name: worked_minutes
columns.note: adjusted: span minus break; otherwise IN/OUT pairing (single segment deducts the shift break, multi-segment trusts break punches)

columns.name: open_now
columns.note: checked in and still inside a normal working window at ATTENDANCE_AS_OF: in progress, not a missing punch

columns.name: grace_credit_minutes
columns.note: arriving inside the grace window is not penalised when deciding full / half day

columns.name: day_credit
columns.note: paid-day credit 0..1 consumed by payroll

tabs.name: ATTENDANCE_ADJUSTMENTS
tabs.purpose: Regularisation and corrections. Original punches are never edited; approved adjustments override the effective in/out in ATTENDANCE_DAILY.

columns.name: locked_violation
columns.note: approved after the covering period was locked

tabs.name: ATTENDANCE_EXCEPTIONS
tabs.purpose: Registry of missing punches, unusual hours and unresolved conflicts detected from ATTENDANCE_DAILY.exception_flag. WAIVED entries stop blocking payroll.

tabs.name: OVERTIME
tabs.purpose: OT requests and approvals. payable_minutes = MIN(approved, formula-calculated OT) so payroll never pays more than attendance supports.

tabs.name: TIMESHEETS
tabs.purpose: Project / task time where enabled, reconciled against attendance worked hours.

tabs.name: SALARY_COMPONENTS
tabs.purpose: Component definitions and their statutory flags (PF wage, ESI wage, taxable). Flags drive the statutory wage formulas.

tabs.name: EMPLOYEE_SALARY
tabs.purpose: Effective-dated monthly salary assignment. A revision is a NEW row with a later effective_from; old rows are never edited.

tabs.name: PAYROLL_CONTROL
tabs.purpose: Payroll period lifecycle OPEN -> PROCESSING -> REVIEW -> APPROVED -> LOCKED. LOCKED is terminal; a new version/off-cycle run is required for changes.

tabs.name: PAYROLL_INPUTS
tabs.purpose: One row per employee x period. Manual inputs (bonus, incentive, arrears, adjustments) are separated from formula-derived attendance / leave / OT / loan / reimbursement inputs.

columns.name: arrears
columns.note: retro / revision arrears, approved amount

columns.name: manual_adjustment
columns.note: signed, requires reason

tabs.name: PAYROLL_CALC
tabs.purpose: Formula-driven payroll calculation. Salary is effective-dated with mid-period revision blending; components are prorated by paid days; statutory results come from STATUTORY_CALC.

columns.name: rev_date
columns.note: mid-period salary revision date (single revision per period supported)

tabs.name: PAYROLL_SNAPSHOT
tabs.purpose: Immutable VALUES copy of PAYROLL_CALC written at LOCK. Locked periods are reported from here so history is reproducible after salary / policy / rule changes.

tabs.name: PAYSLIPS
tabs.purpose: Payslip index. PDFs live in a restricted Drive folder; only IDs and checksums are stored here.

tabs.name: LOANS
tabs.purpose: Loan / advance master. EMI is computed with PMT in the sheet.

tabs.name: LOAN_SCHEDULE
tabs.purpose: Installments. Rows are SCHEDULED until payroll lock marks them DEDUCTED.

tabs.name: EXPENSES
tabs.purpose: Expense claims and approval state. Approved claims create REIMBURSEMENTS rows.

tabs.name: REIMBURSEMENTS
tabs.purpose: Approved reimbursement inputs consumed by PAYROLL_INPUTS (status APPROVED, matching period_id).

tabs.name: TAX_DECLARATIONS
tabs.purpose: Employee tax declarations and proofs (inputs to finance TDS computation).

tabs.name: STATUTORY_RULES
tabs.purpose: Versioned, effective-dated statutory configuration (PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, OT multipliers, gratuity). Seeded values are ILLUSTRATIVE and must be verified against current law before production.

tabs.name: STATUTORY_CALC
tabs.purpose: Statutory results (PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS). All rates/thresholds are read from effective-dated STATUTORY_RULES rows; nothing is hard-coded.

columns.name: tds
columns.note: manual amount (finance computes slab tax externally) or optional flat-rate rule; full slab engine is a configurable extension

tabs.name: FULL_FINAL
tabs.purpose: Full & final settlement. Leave encashment, notice recovery, gratuity and loan recovery are formulas over ledger / salary / rule data.

tabs.name: NOTIFICATIONS
tabs.purpose: Notification outbox (email / SMS / WhatsApp / in-app). Adapters drain QUEUED rows.

tabs.name: AUDIT_LOG
tabs.purpose: Immutable audit trail: who, what, when, source, before, after, reason, request id. entry_hash chains each row to the previous one for tamper evidence.

tabs.name: ERROR_LOG
tabs.purpose: Application and system errors (no secrets, no biometric data, no full payloads).

tabs.name: DASHBOARD_DATA
tabs.purpose: Pre-shaped dashboard metrics, formula health checks and capacity monitors. Every value is a formula.

tabs.name: LOOKUPS
tabs.purpose: Controlled dropdown lists. One column per list; header is the list name.

tabs.name: README
tabs.purpose: Human readable description of every tab and how it is protected.
